LoraTesterSampler.description: Tests one to three LoRAs with fixed sampling inputs, decodes every result, and assembles a labeled comparison sheet.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: The base diffusion model. Every comparison cell starts from this model.

clip.name: CLIP
clip.tooltip: The base CLIP model used to encode prompts inside this node.

vae.name: VAE
vae.tooltip: Decodes each sampled latent before it is added to the comparison sheet.

latent_image.name: Latent
latent_image.tooltip: The source latent reused for every test. Batch size must be 1.

positive_prompt.name: Positive Prompt
positive_prompt.tooltip: Positive prompt encoded inside the node. Active LoRA trigger words are prepended in A/B/C order.

negative_prompt.name: Negative Prompt
negative_prompt.tooltip: Negative prompt encoded inside the node for every LoRA combination.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: The same seed is reused for every image in this comparison run.

steps.name: Steps
steps.tooltip: Sampling steps used for every comparison image.

cfg.name: CFG
cfg.tooltip: Classifier-free guidance used for every comparison image.

sampler_name.name: Sampler
sampler_name.tooltip: KSampler algorithm used for the full comparison run.

scheduler.name: Scheduler
scheduler.tooltip: Noise scheduler used for the full comparison run.

denoise.name: Denoise
denoise.tooltip: Denoising strength used for every comparison image.

lora_count.name: LoRA Count
lora_count.tooltip: Uses the first one, two, or three LoRA groups. The unused groups are hidden automatically.

lora_a_name.name: LoRA A File
lora_a_name.tooltip: LoRA file assigned to slot A.

lora_a_trigger.name: LoRA A Trigger Words
lora_a_trigger.tooltip: Prepended to the positive prompt whenever LoRA A is active.

lora_a_max_strength.name: LoRA A Max Strength
lora_a_max_strength.tooltip: Maximum model and CLIP strength. The grid tests 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% of this value.

lora_b_name.name: LoRA B File
lora_b_name.tooltip: LoRA file assigned to slot B.

lora_b_trigger.name: LoRA B Trigger Words
lora_b_trigger.tooltip: Prepended after A trigger words whenever LoRA B is active.

lora_b_max_strength.name: LoRA B Max Strength
lora_b_max_strength.tooltip: Maximum model and CLIP strength. The grid tests 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% of this value.

lora_c_name.name: LoRA C File
lora_c_name.tooltip: LoRA file assigned to slot C.

lora_c_trigger.name: LoRA C Trigger Words
lora_c_trigger.tooltip: Prepended after A/B trigger words whenever LoRA C is active.

lora_c_max_strength.name: LoRA C Max Strength
lora_c_max_strength.tooltip: Maximum model and CLIP strength. The grid tests 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% of this value.

color_mode.name: Color Mode
color_mode.tooltip: Changes only the comparison sheet styling, not image generation.

show_lora_details.name: Show LoRA Details Footer
show_lora_details.tooltip: Shows the original A/B/C LoRA names and configured maximum strengths below the sheet.

max_canvas_megapixels.name: Maximum Canvas (MP)
max_canvas_megapixels.tooltip: Stops the run when the final RGB comparison sheet would exceed this pixel count.

custom_style.name: Custom Style
custom_style.tooltip: Optional output from LoRA Tester Style. Used only when Color Mode is Custom.

0.name: Comparison Sheet
0.tooltip: The decoded and labeled LoRA comparison sheet.

LoraTesterStyle.description: Builds an optional custom visual style for the LoRA Tester sampler.

background_color.name: Background Color
background_color.tooltip: Canvas background color as a hex value.

placeholder_color.name: Placeholder Color
placeholder_color.tooltip: Color of image slots before they are filled.

text_color.name: Text Color
text_color.tooltip: Primary axis and footer text color.

background_fit.name: Background Fit
background_fit.tooltip: How the optional background image fills the final canvas.

background_opacity.name: Background Opacity
background_opacity.tooltip: Opacity of the optional background image.

decorator.name: Decorator
decorator.tooltip: Optional visual treatment drawn around the comparison matrix.

outer_margin.name: Outer Margin
outer_margin.tooltip: Padding around the full comparison sheet.

cell_gap.name: Cell Gap
cell_gap.tooltip: Gap between adjacent image cells in one region.

region_gap.name: Region Gap
region_gap.tooltip: Larger separation between LoRA mixing regions.

footer_gap.name: Footer Gap
footer_gap.tooltip: Space above the LoRA details footer.

footer_padding.name: Footer Padding
footer_padding.tooltip: Inner padding of the LoRA details footer.

frame_width.name: Region Frame Width
frame_width.tooltip: Width of structural and region frames.

cell_frame_width.name: Image Frame Width
cell_frame_width.tooltip: Width of each image cell frame.

font_path.name: Font Path
font_path.tooltip: Optional local TTF, TTC, or OTF path. Empty selects a system font automatically.

font_size.name: Axis Title Size
font_size.tooltip: 0 dynamically selects a title size from the full sheet dimensions.

small_font_size.name: Axis Value Size
small_font_size.tooltip: 0 dynamically selects a proportional axis value size.

show_axis_labels.name: Show Axis Labels
show_axis_labels.tooltip: Shows LoRA names and strength ticks beside each region.

show_region_frames.name: Show Region Frames
show_region_frames.tooltip: Draws frames around the pairwise mixing regions.

show_special_cell_labels.name: Show Triple-Mix Labels
show_special_cell_labels.tooltip: Shows A/B/C weight labels below the eight triple-mix images.

show_cell_captions.name: Show Every Cell Caption
show_cell_captions.tooltip: Shows a weight caption above every occupied image cell.

show_region_labels.name: Show Region Labels
show_region_labels.tooltip: Shows AB, AC, BC, and ABC labels for their regions.

show_coordinates.name: Show Coordinates
show_coordinates.tooltip: Shows matrix coordinates for layout diagnostics.

background_image.name: Background Image
background_image.tooltip: Optional single IMAGE used behind the comparison matrix.

0.name: Style
0.tooltip: Custom style configuration for LoRA Tester.
